newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Transnet mulling unit sale to MTN - paper.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Transnet mulling unit sale to MTN - paper.

text.p: South African parastatal Transnet is in talks on the sale of of its loss-making Transtel Cellular phone division to network provider Mobile Telephones Network (MTN), Business Day newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The paper said confidential documents, including minutes of a meeting between MTN and Transnet executives, showed that the sale was being discussed.
However, the paper quoted a public enterprises ministry spokesman as saying the government was unaware of the plans to sell the company.
It also said Transnet managing director Saki Macozoma had said Transnet was not planning to sell the operation, but just discussing the possible transference of some services to MTN.
